title: Act: Frame StoryPanel and add portrait dialogue card with choices list
summary: Add portraitPath helper and rebuild the StoryPanel root, title, dialogue card and choices.
description: Implement a pure helper that resolves a portrait URL from the manifest and use it in StoryPanel's dialogue card; frame the root and make it scroll alone.
acceptance_criteria: portraitPath of an unknown speaker returns undefined
StoryPanel root has sf-frame-panel and overflow-y-auto
technical_constraints: React and TypeScript stay; fonts and art stay in-repo.
definition_of_done: Dialogue card shows portrait when manifest has it
Choices render as a list of buttons

steps.action: Create module importing manifestJson from '../../../public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json'; export portraitPath(speaker: string): string | undefined that finds the asset with id `character:${speaker}-portrait` and returns `/assets/${asset.path}`, else undefined.
steps.code: export function portraitPath(speaker: string): string | undefined { const a = manifestJson.assets.find((x) => x.id === `character:${speaker}-portrait`); return a ? `/assets/${a.path}` : undefined; }
steps.expected: portraitPath('boy') returns '/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/characters/boy-portrait.png'; unknown speaker returns undefined.

steps.action:
Replace the root className with 'story-content sf-frame-panel h-full overflow-y-auto p-3 text-sm'. Keep h1 for sceneTitle. In the Dialogue section keep sf-frame-parchment, add a flex row with rendered only when portraitPath returns a value, then h2 speaker and p text. Render choices as
    with one
steps.expected: Component renders framed panel, portrait card and a Choices list; onChoose(index) still fires.
